title: ServiceFlow ITSM platform (fictional)
summary: ServiceFlow is an ITSM platform aligned with ITIL 4 covering incident, problem, change and asset management. It is hosted in a CST-licensed data centre in Riyadh, so service management data is stored within the Kingdom. It includes an Arabic and English self-service portal and knowledge base.

title: Information security policy aligned to NCA ECC
summary: Falcon's information security policy is aligned to the NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-2:2024) and is reviewed annually by the security committee.

title: Transition and knowledge transfer methodology
summary: Falcon's transition methodology runs a 90-day plan in three phases: discovery, shadowing and handover. Knowledge transfer from the incumbent is captured in the knowledge base before go-live.

title: Service desk operating model and service levels
summary: Falcon runs bilingual service desks in Arabic and English 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Standard service levels are a 15-minute response and 4-hour resolution for priority 1 incidents. Falcon guarantees 99.9% monthly availability and offers service credits for breaches.

title: Integrity Pledge (Annex B), completed template
summary: The Integrity Pledge form (Annex B) is completed and ready for signature by the authorised signatory.
